events.description: A title card for 'IS IT CAKE? HALLOWEEN' is displayed in the upper left corner.
The stage lights flash brightly, revealing four pedestals numbered 1 through 4 with objects on top.
The camera pans across three dark, hooded figures standing in a row.
A dark, hooded figure holding a scythe stands still against a blue background.
A woman with glasses and a bun, wearing an orange shirt and black apron, looks on with a neutral expression.
A woman in a pink shirt and a man in a black shirt with bee-patterned glasses look toward the stage.
A woman in a red shirt reacts with surprise, placing her hand on her chest.
A man in a yellow and black striped suit and yellow hat speaks with an expressive face.
A close-up shot shows the four pedestals with dark, hooded figures on top, numbered 1 through 4.
A countdown timer showing ':20' appears on the screen as three contestants stand at their podiums.
The red-shirt woman looks toward the center of the stage with a concerned expression.
The yellow-striped-suit man looks toward the center of the stage.
The black-suit woman looks toward the center of the stage with her eyes closed.
The black-suit man speaks while gesturing with his right hand.
The stage lights brighten to reveal four pedestals numbered 1 to 4, each holding a grim reaper statue.
The yellow-striped-suit man reacts with a surprised expression.
A close-up shot shows pedestal number 1 with a grim reaper statue and a purple hand reaching out from the moss.
The red-shirt woman speaks while looking toward the pedestals.
The camera cuts from the red-shirt woman back to a close-up of pedestal number 1.
A close-up shot shows pedestal number 2 with a grim reaper statue and a purple hand reaching out from the moss.
the glasses woman in an orange shirt and black apron looks toward the left side of the frame
participants: glasses woman in orange shirt and black apron
events.actor: glasses woman in orange shirt and black apron
